headline: Ministry of Trade Takes Action! 360,000 Firms Inspected in 9 Months, 2.6 Billion Lira in Fines Imposed
summary: Turkey's Ministry of Trade inspected 360,578 firms and about 44 million products in the first nine months of the year. Administrative fines totalling 2.6 billion lira were imposed where non-compliance was found.
why: Consumer-protection and trade-compliance enforcement affects retailers and manufacturers, and fine levels signal regulatory intensity in Turkey's market.
